new_scholarship.name: Trent University International Entrance Scholarships
new_scholarship.duration: Renewable at the start of each new academic year; converts to the In-course Scholarship after year one
new_scholarship.deadline: No separate application - considered automatically with the admission application
new_scholarship.application_period: All international undergraduate applicants to Trent are automatically assessed. No separate scholarship application exists for the entrance award.
new_scholarship.description: Trent University automatically assesses every international undergraduate applicant for its International Entrance Scholarships, worth $2,500 to $5,500 per academic year and renewable over the degree. Awards are tiered by Canadian-equivalent high school average, from $2,500 at 80-84.9% up to $5,500 at 95-100%.
new_scholarship.best_fit: An international applicant to a Trent undergraduate degree programme with a Canadian-equivalent final high school average of 80% or above.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: International students paying international fees, studying in Canada on a study permit, who have applied to a Trent undergraduate degree programme and hold a final Canadian-equivalent high school average of 80% or higher. Postgraduate certificates and graduate-level students are not eligible.
eligibility: Studying in Canada on a study permit
Applied to an undergraduate degree programme at Trent University - postgraduate certificates and graduate-level students are explicitly not eligible
Meets Trent admission requirements including general, degree-specific and English Language Proficiency requirements
Final Canadian-equivalent high school average of 80% or higher
Fulfils the conditions of the conditional offer letter and registers for courses
coverage: Tuition funding from $2,500 to $5,500 per academic year, renewable
Total potential over four years ranges from $10,000 to $22,000 by tier
benefits: 95-100% Canadian equivalent: $5,500 per academic year, $22,000 total over four years
Renewable each year on reapplication while maintaining a minimum 80% average in a full course load
Can be paired with Trent International Prestigious Scholarships for a larger total package
requirements: Hold a Canadian-equivalent final high school average of 80% or higher
Fulfil the conditions of the conditional offer letter
Register for courses and pay Fall and Winter term course fees for the first undergraduate year
Maintain a minimum 80% average in a full course load each year to renew
new_scholarship.english_requirement: Must meet Trent University English Language Proficiency Requirements; no specific score is published on the scholarship pages read
new_scholarship.selection_notes: The award amount is determined by the Canadian equivalent of the high school average used for admission consideration. All scholarship values, eligibility requirements and criteria are subject to change without notice.
new_scholarship.notes: After the first year the Entrance Scholarship converts to the In-course Scholarship, which is the renewable portion and requires an annual application through the myTrent portal.

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to a Trent undergraduate degree programme - no separate entrance scholarship application exists
Hold a Canadian-equivalent final high school average of 80% or higher to qualify at all
Meet the English Language Proficiency Requirements
Fulfil the conditions of your conditional offer letter and register for courses
Pay Fall and Winter term course fees for your first year
If you want a larger package, submit the International Undergraduate Scholarships & Awards application in the myTrent portal, which covers all Prestigious Scholarships at once
Maintain a minimum 80% average in a full course load each year to renew
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a postgraduate certificate or graduate programme, which is explicitly ineligible
Holding a Canadian-equivalent average below 80%, which is the floor for any tier
Dropping below an 80% average in a full course load and losing renewal
Forgetting that after year one the award becomes the In-course Scholarship, which requires a separate annual application
Missing the rolling Prestigious Scholarship rounds, which are dated per cycle rather than open-ended
estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above the awarded tier value, from $2,500 to $5,500 per year against full international tuition
Second and later year amounts on the Prestigious Scholarships, whose published maximum is disputed between official pages
Travel, immigration and permanent residence costs
document_audit: No documents for the entrance scholarship, since assessment is automatic
MyTrent applicant portal application for Prestigious Scholarships
English Language Proficiency evidence as part of the admission application
